title: ToolchainInfo
description: The bundled components recorded for this target's reviewed lock.

components.description: Every top-level component in the target's bundle, in lock order.

revision.description: Revision of the reviewed toolchain lock.

target.description: Release target triple whose lock was projected into this summary.

ToolchainComponent.description: One bundled component as the About screen lists it.

id.description: Stable component id from the lock, such as `ffmpeg` or `encoder:aom`.

license.description: SPDX licence expression recorded for the component.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the artifact recorded in the lock.

source_url.description: Provenance URL for the source or package the artifact came from.
